Dear Madam
I am sorry I mistook but indeed I would not think of your copying out the index for me, as I really know pretty well by long use where to find anything that I want so that I lose no time over it.[^1]
I should be very sorry to give you all the trouble.

Yours truly,

C M Yonge

[^1]: Her correspondent is evidently offering to index the [Monthly Packet](../others.html#52).
